title: Run-Length Encoding
prompt: Implement run-length encode/decode for strings. Encoding: each run is <char><count> where count is one or more decimal digits (e.g. "aaabbc" -> "a3b2c1", "a" -> "a1"). Empty string encodes to empty. decode returns an error for malformed input (missing count, count < 1, empty count). Round-trip: decode(encode(s)) == s for alphanumeric inputs.
